scenes.say: Can Madras eye spread just by looking at someone? Let's find out.

scenes.en: It spreads through hands, towels and things we touch, not by looking.
scenes.say: That's a myth. Conjunctivitis, the eye infection we call Madras eye, spreads through hands, towels and things we touch, not by looking at someone.

scenes.en: Use soap, and don't touch or rub your eyes.
scenes.say: So wash your hands with soap often, and don't touch or rub your eyes.

scenes.en: Keep a separate towel and pillow. Don't share eye makeup or eye drops.
scenes.say: Keep a separate towel and pillow, and don't share eye makeup or eye drops.

scenes.en: They ease the glare, but clean hands stop the spread.
scenes.say: Dark glasses can make light more comfortable, but they don't stop the spread. Clean hands do.

scenes.en: Don't use drops on your own. See an eye specialist.
scenes.say: Red, sticky or painful eyes? Don't put drops on your own. See an eye specialist and get an eye test.
